actions.description: Follow up directly with the new branch manager — by name, in person — on the portfolio expansion decision. At tick 10 I requested the meeting and presented the Amir Patel EV charger loan as proof-of-concept. This tick I need the answer: yes, the scope expansion is approved, or no, and if no, what is the formal rationale and what would change the answer. I do not accept ambiguity. The Amir Patel loan is a live transaction I originated under existing credentials. I come with one additional data point: auto loan volume has continued declining to index 79 while the broader small business environment is generating new credit demand from adapters like Amir Patel, Betty Kowalski, and the 10 people enrolled in retraining this month who will need personal loans for living expenses. The bank's value is in deploying credit where the economy needs it, not in waiting for the auto sector to recover.
actions.expected_outcome: Definitive answer on portfolio expansion to small business and personal loan origination. If approved, formal documentation of the expanded scope that does not depend on any single manager's memory. If not approved, a clear rationale that I can address or escalate.

actions.description: Hold the third Community Center Financial Triage Navigator session with an updated agenda. Lisa Freeman launched the Financial Triage Navigator concept this tick and Maria Santos is publicly endorsing it. Kevin O'Brien's office hours are the banking arm of that infrastructure. This session I add a specific new item: what the $2,500 retraining grant actually looks like in terms of financial survivability — how many months does it extend runway at different spending levels, and what documentation does the bank need to see from a retraining enrollee who applies for a personal loan to bridge to the new credential. I am answering the question that the 10 new retraining enrollees this month will have in 60-90 days. I am also connecting directly with Lisa Freeman to formally offer Kevin O'Brien's office hours as the banking component of the Financial Triage Navigator. That relationship has institutional value regardless of what happens with my portfolio expansion.
actions.expected_outcome: Third Community Center session completed. Formal connection established with Lisa Freeman's Financial Triage Navigator initiative. Position Kevin O'Brien as the banking resource embedded in that community infrastructure — creating visibility that protects my role regardless of management transition.

actions.description: Advance NMLS mortgage origination training — complete module 7 this tick, which covers underwriting standards for residential properties. This is the technical module that connects the compliance and credit skills I have from auto lending to the property-based risk assessment that mortgage origination requires. I document completion and log a second co-originator session with a senior mortgage officer — supervised client-facing exposure that I need for credential completion. NMLS progress is now at approximately 30% of the full certification pathway.
actions.expected_outcome: NMLS module 7 complete. Second co-originator session logged. Training progress documented in HR system. Certification pathway advances toward credential completion, which is the 10-month transformation that converts my role from auto-only to mortgage-licensed community banker.

actions.description: Follow up on the Amir Patel EV charger loan application status. I originated this loan at tick 9 as a proof-of-concept for the portfolio expansion. The application has been in the underwriting pipeline for two ticks. I check the status internally — has it moved through credit review, and if so, what is the approval timeline? I communicate the status clearly to Amir Patel: he paused this loan at tick 9 to run the logistics buyer inquiry, but the 60-day gate is approaching and he needs to know the loan is ready to activate if the sale path produces no buyer. Having a current approval in hand — not a tick-5 term sheet — is the right posture for Amir as he approaches his decision gate.
actions.expected_outcome: Amir Patel has current, accurate information on the EV charger loan status. If the application is approved, he can activate it the moment his buyer inquiry produces no signal at day 60. If there are underwriting questions, I resolve them now rather than at the moment Amir needs to move quickly.

reasoning: Tick 11 for Kevin O'Brien is about closing the institutional ambiguity that has been the central unresolved thread since tick 8. The portfolio expansion decision has been waiting too long. The Amir Patel loan is live, the community center sessions are established, the NMLS training is advancing — these are concrete deliverables that demonstrate the value of the expansion. The Financial Triage Navigator launch by Lisa Freeman, publicly endorsed by Maria Santos, is an institutional development Kevin O'Brien should formally connect to this tick. Being the banking arm of that navigator is not a favor — it is a strategic positioning move that makes Kevin O'Brien's community center presence part of Millfield's official economic response infrastructure rather than a voluntary side project. Savings are approximately $18,012 (state $21,913 minus $3,901 tick 10 burn), runway is approximately 5 months. The portfolio expansion and NMLS credential are the two structural moves that change the math before the runway expires.
